text:
Taylor - People Ops: quick one  Morgan has an internal transfer + promotion where manager wants the title and base effective 2026-09-01 but transfer paperwork date is 2026-09-10. can salary be retro'd to 9/1 and what approvals/docs are needed? cc @Priya @Eli

Morgan - Eng Manager: team budgeted headcount from 9/1 so we'd like comp effective at month start. employee is current internal transfer (already on payroll). signed transfer form will be dated 9/10.

Eli - Comp: since they're already on payroll it's easier. need manager approval + comp sign-off + an amendment that sets the effective date. we pro-rate retro by days: ((new_annual - old_annual)/365) * days_prior. equity/grant: do not backdate grants that change vesting without approval.

Priya - Payroll: operationally we can run a manual retro for Sept if docs are in before cutoff (2026-09-25 23:59 PST). required: signed amendment, comp calc, payroll reason code. sample command:
run_retro --eid 022334 --period 2026-09 --retro_start 2026-09-01 --amount <backpay> --note "internal transfer retro"

Sam - HRBP: benefits remain unchanged for existing employee. title change in HRIS can go to 9/1 if amendment present. inform employee about pay timing.

Ruth - Legal: since this is internal (employee already employed) most jurisdictions are fine but confirm if employee is in Germany/France etc. Upload amendment w/ tax acknowledgement and we'll sign off.

people-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff for Sept manual adjustments is 2026-09-25 23:59 PST :bell:

Taylor - People Ops: action list: 1) Morgan attach signed amendment + manager approval. 2) Eli posts backpay calc. 3) Priya confirms run when docs ready. 4) Ruth confirms country OK if flagged. I'll close when payroll run authorized. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
